## Checklist

- [ ] I used canonical links and checked for duplicates.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual, concise, and not copied from abstracts.
- [ ] New resources meet the scope in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I disclosed my relationship to submitted work.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] I added an isolation warning if model-generated code is executed.
- [ ] Primary category and first Targets label agree; secondary artifacts evolve independently.
- [ ] I updated any affected evidence card with source locations and actual review scope.
- [ ] I regenerated the survey exports and ran `node scripts/build-survey-catalog.mjs --check`.
- [ ] Local Node, community structure, YAML, and link checks passed, or limitations are reported.
